# Verifiable

Verifiable is the modern infrastructure for healthcare credentialing. We are on a mission to reduce administrative waste and move healthcare forward through industry-leading technology, APIs, and autonomous AI.In 2020, we modernized credentialing with the industry’s only truly API-first platform. Today, we are setting a new standard with the launch of CredAgentTM: the first autonomous agent designed to automate end-to-end credentialing with human oversight.Scaling network operations has historically meant growing headcount. Now, as healthcare organizations confront credentialing backlogs and tighter resources, agentic AI changes the equation. CredAgentTM enables a single credentialing specialist to manage a team of agents, unlocking 10X productivity and improved operating margins.We’re helping healthcare organizations reclaim operational control, reduce costs, and prioritize patient access. Welcome to the future of credentialing.

## Capital raised

Verifiable has raised $47M across 4 rounds since 2020 - from a $3M Seed Round to a $27M Series B - most recently 1,179 days ago.

1. Jul 2023

In July 2023, Verifiable raised $27M in a Series B round led by Craft Ventures, with Struck Capital, Jack Altman, Highland Capital Partners, Duro Ventures, and Cooley participating.

2. Aug 2021

In August 2021, Verifiable raised $17M in a Series A round led by Sam Altman, with Jack Altman, Zeno Partners, Todd Goldberg, Tiger Global Management, and Struck Capital participating.

3. Oct 2020

In October 2020, Verifiable raised $3M in a Seed Round round led by Y Combinator, with Tiger Global Management, Struck Capital, Soma Capital, Sahil Lavingia, and Rebel Fund participating.
